cards.name: Bilt Blue Card

earn.note: Hotels booked through the Bilt Travel portal, per the card page; the terms describe it as a Bilt Travel partner bonus on top of the card rate.
Flights booked through the Bilt Travel portal, per the card page.
Lyft rides after linking accounts; rate from the card page FAQ. Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants earn a variable bonus ("up to") that is not modeled. Requires enrollment or activation.

Housing-only option: 1.25x on rent and mortgage paid through Bilt when everyday spend in the billing cycle is at least 100% of the housing payment. Below 25% the cycle earns a flat 250 points. No annual cap.

cards.notes: Not modeled: Bilt Cash earned alongside the points (4 per dollar, 4% Bilt Cash on everyday spend). The rent rate is 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x depending on the cardholder's rewards option and everyday spend ratio tier; the highest is shown. The app can't tell booking types apart on the issuer's travel site, so the best of these rates applies to every booking there: Bilt Travel hotels (3x); Bilt Travel flights (2x). Not modeled, for lack of a matching category: Mortgage payments. Changes announced for 2027-01-01 are not reflected yet. Issued by Column N.A. and serviced by Cardless; launched 2026-02-07 to replace the Wells Fargo-issued Bilt Mastercard.

cards.name: Bilt Obsidian Card

earn.note: Hotels booked through the Bilt Travel portal, per the card page; the terms describe it as a Bilt Travel partner bonus on top of the card rate.
Flights booked through the Bilt Travel portal, per the card page.
Lyft rides after linking accounts; rate from the card page FAQ. Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants earn a variable bonus ("up to") that is not modeled. Requires enrollment or activation.

Housing-only option: 1.25x on rent and mortgage paid through Bilt when everyday spend in the billing cycle is at least 100% of the housing payment. Below 25% the cycle earns a flat 250 points. No annual cap.
3x on dining when dining is the selected bonus category (the default). Restaurants, bars, bakeries and fast food by Mastercard MCC. Uncapped.
3x at grocery stores and supermarkets when grocery is the selected bonus category, on up to $25,000 a calendar year, then 1x.
Purchases made directly with airlines, hotels, cruise lines and car rental agencies by Mastercard MCC; other travel earns 1x.

cards.notes: Not modeled: Bilt Cash earned alongside the points (4 per dollar, 4% Bilt Cash on everyday spend). The rent rate is 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x depending on the cardholder's rewards option and everyday spend ratio tier; the highest is shown. Dining (3x) or groceries (3x): earns only on the one the cardholder picks (bonus category); record it on the wallet card. The app can't tell booking types apart on the issuer's travel site, so the best of these rates applies to every booking there: Bilt Travel hotels (4x); Bilt Travel flights (3x). Approximated: the 2x rate on cruises counts for all other travel. Not modeled, for lack of a matching category: Mortgage payments. Changes announced for 2027-01-01 are not reflected yet. Issued by Column N.A. and serviced by Cardless; launched 2026-02-07 to replace the Wells Fargo-issued Bilt Mastercard.
